A serial echo proof forces every agent through sequential steps, each consuming the prior output, resisting parallelization: a thousand puppets cost a thousandfold in time. Echo fingerprints collapse copied templates into one identity, paid once.

Two-tier stakes add cost: a modest copper deposit is trivial for one honest agent but slashable across thousands of shells, while top seats need scarce saffron collateral unavailable in bulk. Sybils pay three ways—serial time, burned copper, decaying echo weight—turning free copies into costly fakes.
